entries.tutorial_instruction_text:
This is a road-and-carrier settlement game. Your job is to build a small working economy.

Goal:
1. Connect buildings to Headquarters with roads.
2. Build a Woodcutter, Forester, Sawmill and Quarry.
3. Store 10 planks and 10 stone.

Start by clicking your Headquarters.

entries.tutorial_instruction_text:
This is a small RTS skirmish. Your goal is to destroy the enemy Command Hub.

You will:
1. Read credits and power.
2. Build a Power Generator and Barracks.
3. Queue a Rifle Squad.
4. Move and attack with your squad.

Start by clicking your Command Hub.

visible_text_blocks.text:
[b]Objective[/b]
Destroy the enemy Command Hub to win the skirmish.

1. Build Power Generator and Barracks near your hub.
2. Queue a Rifle Squad at the Barracks.
3. Select your squad and attack the enemy base.

○ Produce Rifle Squad — 0 / 1 ready.
○ Destroy enemy Command Hub — Set Attack Posture on the enemy base.
